decision.rationale: The dispute is within the time limit. TXN-008088 posted on 2026-07-31 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-31, which is 92 days later, inside the 120-day limit. The authorisation AUTH-008279 was for 119.56 EUR (11956 cents). The posted amount is 138.68 EUR (13868 cents), so the difference is 19.12 EUR (1912 cents). The merchant, MER-000047 (Oakhollow Bistro), is in the RESTAURANT category. No receipt is attached, so the cardholder's figure of 119.56 EUR is a claim and not a receipt. The policy allows a restaurant to post up to 20% above the authorised amount as a tip. 20% of 11956 cents is 2391.20 cents, and the 1912-cent difference is within that, so it counts as an agreed tip and not an amount mismatch. The dispute is declined.
